title: Right Livelihood
speaker: Joden Bob Rose
summary: To cultivate right livelihood, we must align our work with our values of love and compassion, being mindful of how our choices impact ourselves and others. This involves cultivating contentment and acceptance, rather than constantly seeking more, and making choices that promote harmony and well-being in nature and society. By reflecting on our own work and considering whether it benefits or harms others, we can make changes to align more closely with the principle of right livelihood.
